/* a multiline comment */ #include <stdio.h> #include <stdint.h> #include "local.h" /* trailing */ #define MAX 10 #define WRAP(x) \ ((x) + 1) #if 0 this is skipped #endif #ifdef DEBUG # define LOG(x) puts(x) #else # define LOG(x) #endif static const char *greeting = "hello \"world\"\n"; static char tab = '\t'; static char oct = '\101'; static char hexc = '\x41'; typedef struct point { int x; unsigned long y; } point_t; enum colour { RED, GREEN, BLUE }; double ratio(int a, int b) { double r = 1.5e3; float f = .5; int h = 0xFFul; int o = 0755; int d = 42L; size_t n = sizeof(point_t); return (double)a / (double)b + r + f + h + o + d + n; } int main(int argc, char **argv) { point_t p = { .x = 1, .y = 2 }; register int i; volatile int v = 0; top: for (i = 0; i < MAX; i++) { switch (i) { case 0: LOG("zero"); break; case 1: { continue; } default: goto top; } } if (argc > 1 && argv != NULL) { printf("%s %d\n", greeting, argc); } else { return 1; } return 0; }
